name: Fox Hills Mall
description: Fox Hills Mall is a premier enclosed shopping destination located in the heart of Culver City, serving the greater Los Angeles area. Originally opened in 1975, this regional shopping center has undergone significant renovations and modernizations to provide a comfortable shopping experience featuring popular national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. Conveniently positioned near major freeways and the thriving Culver City business district, Fox Hills Mall offers easy access for shoppers throughout West Los Angeles and the South Bay.
demographics: Fox Hills Mall serves the diverse Culver City and West Los Angeles communities, drawing from surrounding affluent neighborhoods including Ladera Heights, Baldwin Hills, and Mar Vista.
summary: Fox Hills Mall is a well-established regional shopping center in Culver City offering diverse retail, dining, and entertainment options for the West Los Angeles community.
